unit.title: Greetings, More Letters, and Simple Words

lesson.title: Review Day: Greetings, Letters, and Words
lesson.subject: punjabi

contentBlocks.text: This week you learned greetings, three new letters, family words, and practiced reading in Gurmukhi script! Today is review day.

Let's review everything: say Sat Sri Akal and dhanvaad. Name the three new letters (ਛ, ਜ, ਝ). Say the family words: maa, pita, ghar, paani. Read ਸਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ once more in Gurmukhi script. Which part felt easiest this week? Which would you like more practice with?
Great work this week — you've built real Punjabi vocabulary and reading skills! Next week, we'll keep building on everything you've learned.

objectives: Recall and use all vocabulary and letters learned this week (greetings, ਛ/ਜ/ਝ, family words, script recognition)
Self-identify which part of the week feels most secure and which needs more practice
materialsNeeded: This week's four worksheets, if kept, for a quick flip-back review
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Go through each part of the week together: greetings, letters, family words, script reading.
2. Ask which part felt easiest and which felt hardest.
3. Move to the worksheet: complete the mixed review.
4. Praise effort and progress across the whole week, not just today's recall.
5. Close by previewing that next week continues building Punjabi skills.
differentiationTips: Struggling: spend extra time on whichever single part felt hardest, rather than requiring equal recall of everything
Ready for more: ask the child to use two or more of this week's words together in one spoken sentence
For a child who enjoys teaching, have them 'teach' this week's greetings to a family member
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a review/recall activity — there is no single right/wrong answer. Note which parts of the week the child recalled confidently vs. needed prompting for, to guide next week's pacing.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: A dedicated review day after a full week of new vocabulary and letters matches the platform's established pacing pattern (see every K unit and the Math/ELA/Science/Social Studies 1 units' own Day 5 review lessons) — consolidation before adding more content is essential.
